narr: Strong to severe thunderstorms moved through eastern Oklahoma during the morning of the 28th. These storms produced locally heavy rainfall that resulted in flash flooding, damaging wind gusts, and three tornadoes. Another round of thunderstorms developed across eastern Oklahoma during the evening of the 28th, as a cold front moved into the area. The strongest storms produced damaging wind.||Widespread heavy rainfall of four to six inches, with isolated amounts to eight inches, resulted in significant rises on rivers in eastern Oklahoma. Major flooding occurred along the Illinois River, with moderate flooding along the Poteau River.
ev: Roads were flooded in and around Westville.
Numerous roads were flooded in and around Vian.
Portions of Highway 9 were flooded west of Eufaula.
Portions of Highway 412 were closed between Leach and Kansas due to flooding.
